categories.title: Report
categories.description: Which report formats are saved, and what they leave out.

categories.title: Correlation chart
categories.description: Settings of the parameter-correlation chart.

categories.title: Pattern chart
categories.description: Settings of the diffraction pattern chart.

categories.title: Space group
categories.description: The structure's space group.

categories.title: Cell
categories.description: The lengths and angles of the unit cell.

categories.title: Atom site
categories.description: The atom sites of the structure: position, occupancy and isotropic displacement.

categories.title: Atomic displacement
categories.description: The anisotropic displacement of each anisotropic atom site.

categories.title: Scattering length
categories.description: Neutron coherent scattering lengths that replace the built-in table for an element or isotope.

categories.title: Bond settings
categories.description: How bonds between atoms are found.

categories.title: Appearance
categories.description: How the structure view draws the structure: atoms, colours, labels and what else it shows.

categories.title: Symmetry operator
categories.description: The space group's symmetry operators, in the order a symmetry code refers to them.

categories.title: Atom in the cell
categories.description: Every atom of the unit cell, generated from the atom sites by symmetry.

categories.title: Bond
categories.description: The bonds between the atoms of the cell.

categories.title: Cartesian frame
categories.description: The matrix from fractional to Cartesian coordinates.

categories.title: Experiment type
categories.description: What kind of experiment this is: sample form, beam mode, probe and scattering type.

categories.title: Scattering source
categories.description: The published tables the scattering factors and lengths come from.

categories.title: Data source
categories.description: The file the measured data were read from.

categories.title: Calculation range
categories.description: The grid a pattern is calculated on when no data are measured.

categories.title: Measured data point
categories.description: The measured pattern and the values calculated at each of its points.

categories.title: Instrument
categories.description: The instrument setup and calibration.

categories.title: Peak profile
categories.description: The shape and width of the diffraction peaks.

categories.title: Background
categories.description: The background under the diffraction peaks.

categories.title: Background estimation
categories.description: How the background is estimated from the measured pattern.

categories.title: Absorption
categories.description: The absorption correction.

categories.title: Extinction
categories.description: A single crystal's extinction correction: its type, mosaic distribution and parameters (ADR-0101).

categories.title: Observed reflections
categories.description: Which of a single crystal's reflections count as observed, for its counts and R factors (ADR-0104).

categories.title: Linked structure
categories.description: The structures that contribute to the pattern, each with its scale.

categories.title: Preferred orientation
categories.description: The March-Dollase preferred-orientation correction per structure.

categories.title: Excluded region
categories.description: Ranges of the pattern left out of the fit.

categories.title: Reflection
categories.description: The Bragg reflections of each linked structure.

categories.title: Fitted reflections
categories.description: Which of a single crystal's reflections a fit uses (ADR-0104).

categories.title: Joint-fit weights
categories.description: Each experiment's weight in a joint fit.

categories.title: Fitting mode
categories.description: How the experiments of a project are fitted.

categories.title: Minimizer
categories.description: The minimizer and its settings.

categories.title: Alias
categories.description: Short names for parameters, used in constraints.

categories.title: Constraint
categories.description: Expressions that compute a parameter from others.

categories.title: Fit start value
categories.description: The values the last fit started from, kept so the fit can be undone.

categories.title: Fit result
categories.description: The outcome of the last fit.

categories.title: Experiment fit result
categories.description: The agreement factors of each experiment in the last fit.

categories.title: Structure fit result
categories.description: The agreement factors of each structure in each experiment.

categories.title: Correlation
categories.description: The correlations between the fitted parameters.

categories.title: Sequential fit
categories.description: Which data files a sequential fit runs over.

categories.title: Scan extraction rule
categories.description: Rules that read a value, such as a temperature, from each data file name.

categories.title: Calculated point
categories.description: The calculated pattern the command line writes.

categories.title: Structure curve
categories.description: Each structure's calculated curve, one value per structure at every point of the pattern.

categories.title: Structure curves
categories.description: The structures the per-point curves follow.

categories.title: Report block
categories.description: The name each data block of the CIF report gives itself.

categories.title: Calculator
categories.description: The calculation engine an experiment names.

items.name: length_a
items.description: Unit-cell length a.

items.name: length_b
items.description: Unit-cell length b.

items.name: length_c
items.description: Unit-cell length c.

items.name: angle_alpha
items.description: Unit-cell angle between b and c (degrees; engine converts to radians).

items.name: angle_beta
items.description: Unit-cell angle between a and c (degrees; engine converts to radians).

items.name: angle_gamma
items.description: Unit-cell angle between a and b (degrees; engine converts to radians).

items.name: id
items.description: Unique atom-site identifier.

items.name: type_symbol
items.description: Chemical symbol of the atom at this site.

items.name: wyckoff_letter
items.description: Wyckoff letter of the site in its space group.

items.name: adp_type
items.description: Atomic displacement parameter type: Biso, Uiso, Bani, Uani or beta; Biso when absent (ADR-0082).

options.description: Isotropic, B in Å².
Isotropic, U in Å².
Anisotropic, the B tensor in Å².
Anisotropic, the U tensor in Å².
Anisotropic, the dimensionless β tensor.

items.name: fract_x
items.description: Fractional x-coordinate of the atom site.

items.name: fract_y
items.description: Fractional y-coordinate of the atom site.

items.name: fract_z
items.description: Fractional z-coordinate of the atom site.

items.name: occupancy
items.description: Site occupancy (raw occupancy; m/M multiplicity applied in |F|^2).

items.name: adp_iso
items.description: Isotropic atomic displacement parameter in the site's declared type: B for Biso, U for Uiso (B = 8 pi^2 U); an anisotropic site's equivalent isotropic value, derived (ADR-0082).

items.name: id
items.description: The id of the anisotropic atom site the row belongs to.

items.name: adp_11
items.description: Anisotropic displacement tensor component 11 (diagonal 11) in the site's declared type: U for Uani, B for Bani (Å²), dimensionless beta for beta (ADR-0082).

items.name: adp_22
items.description: Anisotropic displacement tensor component 22 (diagonal 22) in the site's declared type: U for Uani, B for Bani (Å²), dimensionless beta for beta (ADR-0082).

items.name: adp_33
items.description: Anisotropic displacement tensor component 33 (diagonal 33) in the site's declared type: U for Uani, B for Bani (Å²), dimensionless beta for beta (ADR-0082).

items.name: adp_12
items.description: Anisotropic displacement tensor component 12 (off-diagonal 12) in the site's declared type: U for Uani, B for Bani (Å²), dimensionless beta for beta (ADR-0082).

items.name: adp_13
items.description: Anisotropic displacement tensor component 13 (off-diagonal 13) in the site's declared type: U for Uani, B for Bani (Å²), dimensionless beta for beta (ADR-0082).

items.name: adp_23
items.description: Anisotropic displacement tensor component 23 (off-diagonal 23) in the site's declared type: U for Uani, B for Bani (Å²), dimensionless beta for beta (ADR-0082).

items.name: rise_alpha_0
items.description: Back-to-back exponential rise-rate coefficient alpha_0 (rate, 1/us; no closed unit code).

items.name: rise_alpha_1
items.description: Back-to-back exponential rise-rate coefficient alpha_1 (alpha(d)=alpha_0+alpha_1/d).

items.name: decay_beta_0
items.description: Back-to-back exponential decay-rate coefficient beta_0 (rate, 1/us; no closed unit code).

items.name: decay_beta_1
items.description: Back-to-back exponential decay-rate coefficient beta_1 (beta(d)=beta_0+beta_1/d^4).

items.name: broad_gauss_sigma_0
items.description: Gaussian VARIANCE coefficient sigma_0^2 (variance domain; TCH consumes FWHM_G=sqrt(sigma^2)*sqrt(8 ln 2)).

items.name: broad_gauss_sigma_1
items.description: Gaussian VARIANCE coefficient sigma_1^2 (d^2 term; variance domain).

items.name: broad_gauss_sigma_2
items.description: Gaussian VARIANCE coefficient sigma_2^2 (d^4 term; us^2/A^4 not in closed vocab -> none).

items.name: broad_gauss_size
items.description: Gaussian isotropic size broadening (variance contribution).

items.name: broad_gauss_strain
items.description: Gaussian isotropic strain broadening (variance contribution).

items.name: broad_lorentz_gamma_0
items.description: Lorentzian FWHM coefficient gamma_0 (FWHM domain, H_L; consumed as FWHM directly, no sqrt(8 ln 2)).

items.name: broad_lorentz_gamma_1
items.description: Lorentzian FWHM coefficient gamma_1 (d term; FWHM domain).

items.name: broad_lorentz_gamma_2
items.description: Lorentzian FWHM coefficient gamma_2 (d^2 term; FWHM domain).

items.name: broad_lorentz_size
items.description: Lorentzian isotropic size broadening (FWHM).

items.name: broad_lorentz_strain
items.description: Lorentzian isotropic strain broadening (FWHM).

items.name: broad_gauss_u
items.description: Caglioti Gaussian FWHM coefficient U (tan^2(theta) term; H_G^2 in deg^2).

items.name: broad_gauss_v
items.description: Caglioti Gaussian FWHM coefficient V (tan(theta) term; H_G^2 in deg^2).

items.name: broad_gauss_w
items.description: Caglioti Gaussian FWHM coefficient W (constant term; H_G^2 in deg^2).

items.name: broad_lorentz_x
items.description: Lorentzian FWHM coefficient X, strain-like (tan(theta) term; H_L in deg).

items.name: broad_lorentz_y
items.description: Lorentzian FWHM coefficient Y, size-like (1/cos(theta) term; H_L in deg).

items.name: mixing_eta_0
items.description: Pseudo-Voigt mixing at 2theta = 0: eta = eta_0 + eta_1 2theta (FullProf Eta0).

items.name: mixing_eta_1
items.description: Pseudo-Voigt mixing slope per degree 2theta: eta = eta_0 + eta_1 2theta (FullProf X of Npr 5).

items.name: asym_fcj_1
items.description: Finger-Cox-Jephcoat asymmetry parameter 1: S/L, half the sample height over the diffractometer radius.

items.name: asym_fcj_2
items.description: Finger-Cox-Jephcoat asymmetry parameter 2: D/L, half the detector height over the diffractometer radius.

items.name: asym_beba_a0
items.description: Berar-Baldinozzi asymmetry coefficient A0 (Fa/tan theta).

items.name: asym_beba_b0
items.description: Berar-Baldinozzi asymmetry coefficient B0 (Fb/tan theta).

items.name: asym_beba_a1
items.description: Berar-Baldinozzi asymmetry coefficient A1 (Fa/tan 2theta).

items.name: asym_beba_b1
items.description: Berar-Baldinozzi asymmetry coefficient B1 (Fb/tan 2theta).

items.name: asym_beba_limit
items.description: Berar-Baldinozzi limit angle (deg 2theta): reflections at or above it get no asymmetry correction (FullProf AsyLim); default 180.

items.name: calib_d_to_tof_offset
items.description: TOF calibration zero offset (TOF = zero + Dtt1*d + Dtt2*d^2 + recip/d).

items.name: calib_d_to_tof_linear
items.description: TOF calibration linear coefficient Dtt1 (us/A).

items.name: calib_d_to_tof_quadratic
items.description: TOF calibration quadratic coefficient Dtt2 (us/A^2).

items.name: calib_d_to_tof_reciprocal
items.description: TOF calibration reciprocal (1/d) coefficient (us*A); round-tripped, held fixed in the free set.

items.name: calib_twotheta_offset
items.description: CW zero-point offset in degrees 2theta, subtracted from the observed axis.

items.name: setup_wavelength
items.description: Incident neutron wavelength in angstroms (single wavelength; the doublet tags are X-ray scope).

items.name: calib_sample_displacement
items.description: CW sample-displacement line shift in degrees 2theta (FullProf SyCos): adds displacement*cos(2theta_B) to each reflection's position.

items.name: calib_sample_transparency
items.description: CW sample-transparency line shift in degrees 2theta (FullProf SySin): adds transparency*sin(2theta_B) to each reflection's position.

items.name: setup_polarization_coefficient
items.description: X-ray CW polarization coefficient K (FullProf Rpolarz): the intensity carries P = 1 - K + K cos^2(2theta_m) cos^2(2theta); 0 disables the correction.

items.name: setup_monochromator_twotheta
items.description: X-ray CW pre-specimen monochromator angle 2theta_m in degrees (FullProf stores Cthm = cos^2(2theta_m)); 0 means no monochromator.

items.name: setup_wavelength_2
items.description: X-ray CW second incident wavelength in angstroms (FullProf Lambda2, e.g. Cu K-alpha2); used when setup_wavelength_2_to_1_ratio is not 0.

items.name: setup_wavelength_2_to_1_ratio
items.description: X-ray CW intensity of the second wavelength relative to the first (FullProf Ratio); 0 means a single wavelength.

items.name: abscor1
items.description: TOF sample absorption coefficient ABSCOR1 (muR = ABSCOR1 * lambda; refinable).

items.name: abscor2
items.description: TOF sample absorption lambda-power ABSCOR2 (round-tripped, held fixed; freeing it is a hard error).

items.name: mu_r
items.description: CW cylinder sample absorption mu*R (mu the linear absorption coefficient, R the cylinder RADIUS; evaluated at each reflection's Bragg theta; refinable; C13-T5).

items.name: domain_radius
items.description: Becker-Coppens domain (mosaic block) radius r (micrometres; extinction types II and mixed; single crystal; a fit parameter).

items.name: mosaic_spread
items.description: Becker-Coppens mosaic spread g of the crystal, the inverse width of its mosaic distribution (larger is narrower; radians to the minus one; extinction types I and mixed; single crystal; a fit parameter).

items.name: crystal_radius
items.description: Radius of the crystal taken as a sphere, which sets each reflection's mean path length through it for the Becker-Coppens secondary extinction (millimetres, as _exptl_crystal.size_rad; every Becker-Coppens type; single crystal; a descriptor, never fitted).

items.name: coefficient
items.description: Larson's empirical extinction coefficient x, as SHELXL's EXTI: F2calc is multiplied by [1 + 0.001 x F2calc lambda^3 / sin 2theta]^(-1/2) (extinction type larson-isotropic; single crystal; a fit parameter).

items.name: coefficient_11
items.description: The term of h² in Larson's anisotropic extinction tensor x_aniso = x11 h^2 + x22 k^2 + x33 l^2 + x12 hk + x13 hl + x23 kl, which takes the place of 4 x (sin theta/lambda)^2 (FullProf's Ext1; extinction type larson-anisotropic; single crystal; a fit parameter).

items.name: coefficient_22
items.description: The term of k² in Larson's anisotropic extinction tensor x_aniso = x11 h^2 + x22 k^2 + x33 l^2 + x12 hk + x13 hl + x23 kl, which takes the place of 4 x (sin theta/lambda)^2 (FullProf's Ext2; extinction type larson-anisotropic; single crystal; a fit parameter).

items.name: coefficient_33
items.description: The term of l² in Larson's anisotropic extinction tensor x_aniso = x11 h^2 + x22 k^2 + x33 l^2 + x12 hk + x13 hl + x23 kl, which takes the place of 4 x (sin theta/lambda)^2 (FullProf's Ext3; extinction type larson-anisotropic; single crystal; a fit parameter).

items.name: coefficient_12
items.description: The term of hk in Larson's anisotropic extinction tensor x_aniso = x11 h^2 + x22 k^2 + x33 l^2 + x12 hk + x13 hl + x23 kl, which takes the place of 4 x (sin theta/lambda)^2 (FullProf's Ext4; extinction type larson-anisotropic; single crystal; a fit parameter).

items.name: coefficient_13
items.description: The term of hl in Larson's anisotropic extinction tensor x_aniso = x11 h^2 + x22 k^2 + x33 l^2 + x12 hk + x13 hl + x23 kl, which takes the place of 4 x (sin theta/lambda)^2 (FullProf's Ext5; extinction type larson-anisotropic; single crystal; a fit parameter).

items.name: coefficient_23
items.description: The term of kl in Larson's anisotropic extinction tensor x_aniso = x11 h^2 + x22 k^2 + x33 l^2 + x12 hk + x13 hl + x23 kl, which takes the place of 4 x (sin theta/lambda)^2 (FullProf's Ext6; extinction type larson-anisotropic; single crystal; a fit parameter).

items.name: march_r
items.description: March-Dollase coefficient r (FullProf Pref1, IUCr _pd_pref_orient_March_Dollase.r; 1 = no texture, <1 platy, >1 needle; must be > 0; a fit parameter; C13-T4).

items.name: march_random_fract
items.description: Random (untextured) fraction mixed with the March-Dollase term (FullProf Pref2; a fit parameter; C13-T4).

items.name: scale
items.description: Scale factor of one linked structure's (phase's) pattern, the overall pattern scale when there is one structure (dimensionless; linear).

items.name: intensity
items.description: Line-segment background intensity anchor (dimensionless in the reduced pattern; linear).

items.name: position
items.description: Background anchor position (TOF, us); a fixed node, not a refinable Parameter.

items.name: coef
items.description: Polynomial or Chebyshev background coefficient of the row's order (dimensionless in the reduced pattern; linear).

items.name: order
items.description: Order m of a polynomial or Chebyshev background term (a non-negative integer; a fixed node, not a refinable Parameter).

items.name: origin
items.description: Origin of the polynomial background, FullProf Bkpos: the terms are powers of x/origin - 1 (in the pattern's axis units; non-zero).

items.name: x_min
items.description: Lower end of the Chebyshev background's normalisation domain (in the pattern's axis units).

items.name: x_max
items.description: Upper end of the Chebyshev background's normalisation domain (in the pattern's axis units; above x_min).

Drop it.
